trial_court: Addl. District Judge, Amritsar, Civil Revision No.2147 of 2018
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act for grant of divorce on the ground of cruelty before the Addl. District Judge, Amritsar.

legal_principles.principle: The trial Court would be at liberty to appreciate the relevancy, admissibility and genuineness of the evidence on legal parameters.
legal_principles.held: If the same is found to be in consonance with the pleadings, the same can be relied. If the evidence led by the petitioner is found to be beyond pleadings, the same can be eschewed by the Court.
cited_cases: Bipin Shantilal Panchal vs State of Gujarat, (2001) 1 criminal RCR 859

legal_principles.principle: The Court would test the pleadings made by the petitioner with reference to the affidavit in the form of examination-in-chief.
legal_principles.held: On being cross-examined by the respondent, the trial Court would be at liberty to take final call on merits.
cited_cases: Bipin Shantilal Panchal vs State of Gujarat, (2001) 1 criminal RCR 859

outcome.final_order: The order passed by the trial court was set aside and the matter was remanded back to the trial court for fresh consideration.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
responding to application to strike off pleadings
